exact_result: Proved corrected carrier and test-density statements, necessary finite-energy FS tests with the genuine probability normalization, a repaired continuous mixed-integrability bound, an I-Cauchy estimate for maximizing sequences, and explicit toric model computations including an irrational nondivisorial quasimonomial atom. No intrinsic sufficient condition or general existence theorem is established.
concrete_gaps: Prove normalized genuine cone-psh compactness or strong completeness of E1(xi)/R, beyond decreasing-net closure and pointwise bounds.
Prove cone envelope closure/continuity and orthogonality, or an adequate substitute, and verify all synthetic positivity and test-class identifications before applying the synthetic theorems.
Prove target integration continuity for energy-bounded weakly convergent genuine cone potentials; decreasing FS approximation alone does not supply it.
Prove two-sided extended-energy differentiation for a dense test class and the resulting Euler-Lagrange equality or target identification for maximizing sequences.
Realize completed measures or I-Cauchy potential sequences by actual Wu finite-energy potentials on the invariant carrier; measure completeness and bi-Lipschitzness on the image do not imply this.

If using a rational quotient or varying-Reeb approximation, justify singular quotient hypotheses, invariant metric and carrier preservation, mass/energy normalization, and the required uniformity in nonproportional polarizations. No such general transfer is proved here.
